stories.title: DevDay 2026 Recap
stories.explanation: OpenAI held DevDay 2026, announcing over 20 updates including new models, agents called 'dots', and expanded developer tools for its ecosystem.

stories.title: AMD acquires World Labs AI startup, upping the ante against Nvidia
stories.explanation: Chipmaker AMD announced it will acquire AI company World Labs for $8.2 billion by year's end, pending regulatory approval. This acquisition aims to enhance AMD's capabilities in world models and compete with rivals.

stories.title: OpenAI’s Dots Are Always-On AI Agents—and Its Answer to Meta’s Muse
stories.explanation: OpenAI announced "Dots," new always-on AI agents powered by GPT-6 Astra, at its DevDay 2026 event. These agents are designed to connect to apps and complete multistep tasks for users.

stories.title: From Training to Production, NVIDIA and CoreWeave Close the Loop on Agentic AI
stories.explanation: CoreWeave announced the availability of NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems and the launch of CoreWeave Forge to support the development and production of agentic AI.

stories.title: Anthropic Says It Discovered a Crispr-Like System. Now What?
stories.explanation: Anthropic claimed its Claude large language model identified an enzyme system with properties similar to Crispr after running 950 agents. This marks a potential AI-driven scientific discovery in biology.

stories.title: Here’s how tech leaders will self-police AI safety under Trump’s deal
stories.explanation: Tech leaders including those from Google, Anthropic, and Meta signed a 'Joint Commitment on Frontier Responsibilities,' a self-regulatory AI safety agreement.

stories.title: Introducing SynthID Bio
stories.explanation: Google DeepMind introduced SynthID Bio, a watermarking technology for synthetic biology that embeds signatures into biological code to improve biosecurity and scientific integrity.

stories.title: Google figures out how to watermark AI-designed proteins
stories.explanation: Google's DeepMind team published research on a protein watermarking system intended to help identify and mitigate biosecurity risks associated with AI-designed proteins.

stories.title: Sep 30, 2026EconomicsWhat work can robots do?
stories.explanation: Anthropic published a study using its Claude model to measure job exposure to robots, finding that while robots can perform 74% of physical tasks, they are currently cost-competitive for only 0.3%.

stories.title: Meta disputes claim that Muse read a user’s private messages without permission
stories.explanation: Meta disputed claims that its Muse AI agent accessed private messages without user consent, stating that the feature requires explicit opt-in and system permissions.
